origin.description: Return a function that stores each result and reuses it for the same arguments.

arguments.name: *extras
arguments.text: Zero-argument callables mixed into the cache key. These stand in for one-sided formulas.

arguments.name: cache
arguments.text: Cache object. The default is a dictionary.

arguments.name: omit_args
arguments.text: Argument names left out of the cache key.

arguments.name: hash
arguments.text: Function from the bound arguments to a string key.

origin.details: A second memoise() of a memoised function raises. An old cache that has digest, set, get, and has_key supplies the key function.
origin.example:
n <- 0
f <- function(x, dummy = "a") { n <<- n + 1; x + nchar(dummy) }
m <- memoise(f)
cat(paste(m(2), m(2), m(2, dummy = "a"), n), "\n", sep = "")
